stats.fact: Cursor 3.9 shipped on June 22, 2026 with the new Customize page
Cursor has 7.5 million monthly active developers as of June 2026
Customize page manages 7 extension categories: Plugins, MCPs, Skills, Subagents, Rules, Commands, and Hooks
Three management scopes: user (personal), team (shared across org), workspace (project-specific)
Plugin manifest format: .cursor-plugin/plugin.json with auto-discovery of skills/, rules/, commands/, hooks/ directories
Team marketplaces support GitLab, BitBucket, and Azure DevOps in addition to GitHub as of 3.9
Marketplace leaderboard shows most popular plugins, skills, and MCPs across the team ranked by adoption
Launch marketplace plugins from: Linear, Figma, Stripe, AWS, Cloudflare, Vercel, Databricks, Snowflake, Amplitude, Hex
Plugin canvases: prebuilt shared setup templates (Hex Canvas for data viz, Atlassian Canvas for realtime Jira/Confluence)
MCP servers support three transports: stdio (local subprocess), Streamable HTTP (remote), SSE (deprecated)
Required distribution mode auto-installs plugins for all team members without manual action

angles: The Customize page as Cursor's answer to the fragmentation problem — one UI replacing scattered JSON config files and settings panels
Team leaderboard as a discovery and standardization tool — surface what teammates actually use so adoption happens organically
Plugin format as the future of agent configuration: portable, versioned, shareable bundles replacing manual rule/MCP copy-paste
Multi-repo support (GitLab, BitBucket, Azure DevOps) as the unlock for enterprise teams locked out of GitHub-only ecosystems
Plugin canvases as a new category: interactive setup templates that go beyond static config into live shared dashboards
Custom MCP management in Customize page removes the last remaining reason to edit JSON config files directly
Required distribution mode as a governance tool for platform teams managing Cursor deployments at scale
Comparison with Claude Code: Cursor's Customize page is ahead in UI-based management while Claude Code has better resource support
